svg.aria-label: The tests, run one by one. A counter climbs from 0 to 97 and a strip of 97 cells turns green: first the 34 pure-logic tests, with no device, through flutter test, then the 63 that run on an Android emulator, where SQLCipher and the Keystore exist, through flutter test integration_test. All 97 end up green. Each family lights up when a test that checks it passes. Labels: the merchant comes out of the bank’s noise, and its key does not change from one month to the next. Internal transfers: to savings, from savings, a savings account with an unusual name, and a transfer to someone that is not one. Recurrences: a monthly subscription found with its next date, irregular groceries that are not one. Categorising: the dictionary, corrections learned and followed, and a repeated sync that doubles nothing. Balance: split refunds, merchant refund, cash expense taken off the withdrawals. Wallet: 50 euros counted, a 20 euro withdrawal, 12 euros at the market, 58 left. Budget month: each salary opens its month, even when paid early for Christmas, a bonus opens none, and cash from a withdrawal counts only once. Backup: everything comes back with the right passphrase, a wrong one touches nothing. Signature: the JWT signed in Dart is, byte for byte, the one OpenSSL makes. Refunds: six transfers for one expense, linked either way, never over, even with two writes at the same moment. Syncs: pending transactions that get booked, change amount or are lifted, a year of history, nothing doubles, nothing is lost. Never frozen: every test puts a time limit on its database access, a deadlock would fail the suite instead of freezing it. On device: 97 tests, 34 on pure logic, 63 on an Android emulator.

svg.text: What the 97 tests check, family by family, and where they run.

g.text: flutter test
flutter test integration_test
test/audit_donnees_test.dart
test/rs256_test.dart
integration_test/audit_synchro_test.dart
integration_test/donnees_test.dart
an expense refunded by two incomes does not turn into a gain
a recategorised cheque does not learn the rule “N”
a subscription on 31 January comes back at the end of February, not on 3 March
the salary of 19 December opens January
a bonus or a refund filed as salary opens nothing
the RS256 signature is the one OpenSSL makes
A7 sync run three times: nothing doubles, nothing moves
D5 cash spent the month after the withdrawal: not counted twice
F2 splitting and refunding the same expense at the same time: never more than the expense
F4 a link to a pending transaction the sync deletes: nothing freezes, no orphan link
the merchant comes out of the bank’s noise
to savings: put aside
six friends refund the same expense: €192 now counts as only €54
a salary paid before Christmas opens January, not a second December
a stopped recurring payment is no longer expected, and resumes if it comes back
the wallet lives off withdrawals and cash expenses
an encrypted backup reads back, with the right passphrase only
the test app installs on the Android emulator
A1 a pending transaction whose amount changes when booked (a tip) keeps its note, category, month and link
97 green: 34 with no device, 63 on the emulator.
